ShortDescription.Value: An AI ghostwriter that turns your CS2 playthrough into a living narrative — named characters, civic events, and unfolding stories driven by what you build.

Publish.LongDescription:
**Ghostwriter** is a Cities: Skylines II mod that quietly writes the story of your city in the background while you play. As you build, an LLM-driven agent observes your city's state — population, districts, buildings, pollution, churn, climate, road network, named civic buildings, all of it — and writes the story that explains it. Named characters who plausibly drive its decisions. Civic events as they happen. Ongoing narrative threads that grow with your playthrough. You stay the city's builder; the ghostwriter writes in your voice.
The mod has three halves running together: a C# **sensor** that exports rich ECS state to JSON snapshots, a per-city **storytelling workspace** the agent reasons against, and an **in-game React panel** for talking to the ghostwriter without alt-tabbing CS2.
## What you'll need
A way for the mod to talk to a language model. Several options — pick what fits your setup:
* **Anthropic API** (default): pay-per-use, paste a key from console.anthropic.com. Roughly $0.05 – $0.50 per typical play session at Opus prices; less with Sonnet. * **Claude Code CLI**: uses your existing Claude Code subscription, flat-rate, no per-session bill. Install Claude Code, log in once, switch the provider in Options. * **OpenAI** or **Gemini**: pay-per-use, paste your key. * **Ollama** (local): free, runs entirely on your machine. Install Ollama, pull a model, point Options at localhost.
## How to use it
1. Subscribe to Ghostwriter (Carto auto-installs alongside as a spatial-data peer dependency). 2. Restart CS2, then enable Ghostwriter in the mods list. 3. Open **Options → Ghostwriter**, pick your provider, paste your key (or set up Claude Code), and confirm a model id. 4. Start a new city. Play for a minute. The mod auto-exports a snapshot every 5 minutes (configurable). 5. Click the **Ghostwriter toolbar icon** (top-left of the in-game UI). Run the **/new-city** slash command — the agent reads your fresh city's state and writes its founding canon: premise, era, founding characters. 6. From there, chat freely. Ask the agent who lives where, what just happened in a district, or use **/session-start** and **/session-end** to keep a per-session playthrough log.
## What you'll get
Stories live as plain Markdown files at `LocalLow\Colossal Order\Cities Skylines II\ModsData\CityStoryMod\<your-city>\` — a folder of **canon**, **characters**, **companies**, **places**, **factions**, **events**, **sessions**, **stories**, and **secrets** that grows as your city does. There's an **Open story folder** button in Options if you want to read or back them up directly. The agent treats player-renamed buildings as canon links and weaves them into the world.
## A note on what the model sees
The ghostwriter reads your city's snapshot JSON and any canon files inside its own folder. It does NOT read other saves, other mods' data, or anything outside that folder. If you're using a hosted provider (Anthropic / OpenAI / Gemini), that data is sent to their servers per their terms of service. **Ollama runs entirely on your machine** — pick it if you want full local-only.
## Open source
Ghostwriter is MIT-licensed. Source, issue tracker, and developer docs at github.com/williamlang/city-storytelling-mod.
Publish.ChangeLog:
**0.1.4** — the storyteller now drives the city.
* **Active events.** The ghostwriter periodically proposes story events with 2–4 in-world response options for you to act on in-game. Each event carries an in-world deadline; act in-game and the next snapshot auto-closes the event with consequence canon, or let it expire and the storyteller writes the "ignored" consequence — rivals smell blood, deals collapse, opportunities pass. Off by default; flip the **Active** button in the Ghostwriter panel footer to opt in. The interval (1–60 minutes) lives in Options. * **Open-events inbox.** A new strip above the chat lists every open event with title and deadline, sorted by urgency. Click a card to read the motivating prose, the response options, and what each option needs the city to look like for it to count as done. * **Live countdown.** The Active button shows wall-clock time until the next autonomous run (`Active: on · 4:32`). Freezes when the sim is paused so you can step away without the timer draining. * **Idle-aware.** The autonomous loop suspends when the sim is paused or there's been no keyboard / mouse input for several minutes — the storyteller won't burn provider tokens generating events into a void. * **/story-driven rewritten.** Now writes one open event with multiple in-game response options instead of asking you to pick from a list. You pick by acting in-game; the snapshot tells the storyteller which option you took. * **/events-resolve.** New command that scans open events against the latest snapshot, closes matches as `resolved-by-player`, and expires past-deadline events with timeout consequence canon. Runs manually, automatically after each snapshot export (when Active events is on), and as the first step of `/session-end`. * **Grounded in city state.** Generated events are now scale-appropriate to your city's current funds, population, and milestone level — no stadium pitches to a 5,000-person town. The storyteller checks `city.money`, `city.population`, and `city.milestone` before proposing options. * **Ollama fixes.** Wire-level request/response logging for debugging local-model setups; tolerates leading-slash tool paths some models emit.
